issues.explanation: Guest Livewire routes lack persistent middleware, so an authenticated user can still call Login/Register submit via Livewire update requests.
Full-page components do not declare a Blade layout, so the created layouts/app.blade.php is not wired to the Livewire pages.
Register validates via rules() instead of the project-required #[Validate] attributes used by Login.
Public bool remember has no validation and relies on client-controlled Livewire state.
Rate-limiter hit runs before validation and is never cleared on success, counting valid registrations against the IP budget.

review.summary: Implements the full pt-BR session auth flow with strict validation, throttling, verification hardening, localization and broad Pest coverage. Needs changes before merging due to missing Livewire layout wiring and persistent guest middleware plus the Register #[Validate] deviation.
